notes: Use this divider to move from diagnosing constraints to prioritizing action where Gujarat already has momentum. Emphasize targeting by production system, not blanket statewide schemes. title: Gujarat’s strongest farm opportunities come from targeted resilience and value-capture upgrades in the systems already driving output
subtitle: This section shifts from problem diagnosis to intervention focus, concentrating on the commercial crop, dairy, and horticulture systems where better water use, climate protection, and stronger chain execution can convert existing production strength into more durable smallholder income.
